hypothesis_identity.theory_version: GR + pressureless CDM + cosmological constant; symbolic linear-scalar baseline v0.1

conventions.index_convention: covariant X_munu; mixed/background component labels are bookkeeping only
conventions.M0_definition: constant reduced Planck mass with M0^2=(8*pi*G)^(-1)
conventions.T_known_definition: baryons + photons + standard neutrinos; CDM and Lambda are intentionally left in the residual dark sector
conventions.gauge_or_gauge_invariant_basis: linear scalar expressions recorded in conformal Newtonian gauge; gauge-bound quantities are not claimed gauge invariant

scalar_momentum_velocity.expression_ref: (rho_X+p_X)*theta_X = rho_c*theta_c; Lambda momentum is structural zero

scalar_anisotropic_stress.expression_ref: pi_c=0 and pi_Lambda=0 in the pressureless-CDM + exact-Lambda baseline

sector_bookkeeping.sector_partition_definition: X_total = T_cdm + T_Lambda; both sectors separately conserved in baseline GR

modified_gravity_bookkeeping.original_field_equation_ref: M0^2 G_munu = T_known_munu + T_cdm_munu - rho_Lambda g_munu

stability_conditions: standard GR tensor kinetic sign M0^2>0
other_approximations: linear scalar perturbations only for perturbation components
radiation/neutrino perturbations belong to T_known by convention and are not silently folded into X_munu
